title: Twenty One Zero-Days in FFmpeg
summary: A security researcher discovered and disclosed 21 zero-day vulnerabilities in FFmpeg, a widely-used open-source multimedia framework. The research demonstrates the extensive attack surface of multimedia processing software and highlights critical security issues that could affect numerous applications using FFmpeg.
problem_solved: Identifies and reports multiple critical zero-day vulnerabilities in FFmpeg before they can be exploited by malicious actors.
why_valuable: Discovers 21 critical vulnerabilities in a ubiquitous multimedia framework, helping secure countless applications and services that depend on FFmpeg for media processing.
